title: Tales 009 - Empty Your Cup
style: japanese folk storytelling ballad, shamisen, shakuhachi flute, koto, soft taiko, warm clear male vocal, gentle and wise, crisp diction, 92 bpm, very short song, vocals start immediately

lines: A scholar climbed the mountain to an old master's door
Teach me Zen, he said, though I have read it all before
He talked and talked of everything he knew
The master only smiled and set the tea to brew
He filled the scholar's cup up to the brim
And kept on pouring, over the rim
It ran across the table and down onto the floor
Stop, the scholar cried, it cannot hold any more
You are like this cup, the old man said
Full to the brim with the thoughts in your head
Nothing new can enter, nothing can begin
Empty your cup, and let the world pour in
